text: 8月3日，中国证券业协会国际业务专业委员会主任委员(扩大)会议在北京召开。会议由委员会主任委员、高盛(中国)证券总经理索莉晖主持，协会相关负责人出席会议并致辞，证监会机构司、国际司相关同志，以及委员会副主任委员、委员代表等30余人参加会议。
text_en: On August 3, the International Business Committee Chairman (Expanded) Meeting of the Securities Association of China was held in Beijing. The meeting was chaired by the committee's chairman, Sui Lihui, General Manager of Goldman Sachs (China) Securities. Relevant officials from the association attended and delivered speeches, with over 30 participants including officials from the CSRC's Institution Department and International Department, as well as vice chairmen and member representatives of the committee.
